newsitem.title: UK: Sterling pushes above 3.01 marks to session highs.
newsitem.headline: Sterling pushes above 3.01 marks to session highs.

text.p: 1445 GMT - Stg/mark rises to intraday highs above 3.01 late in Europe, cable pushes back up.
* Stg/mark at 3.0135/45 vs 2.9998/08 late Friday in Europe.
* Stg/mark takes cue from dollar, mark, with no major UK economic data due before Wednesday.
* Broad EMU talk weakened mark after French govt unveiled deficit cuts worth 0.4 pct point of GDP in '97. Deficit expected to total 3.1-3.3 pct of GDP in 1997 despite cuts.
* Waigel says EMU without France, Germany makes little sense. German official says Bonn aims for 3.0 pct deficit in 97.
